traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Saururaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire; veins pinnate or palmate; blades oblong or ovate; stipules present; leaf rosettes none; plants hermaphrodite; ovary usually superior, rarely inferior; stems herbaceous; flowers in racemes or in spikes; flowers actinomorphic; perianth absent; fruit capsule or follicle; stamens 3 to 8; carpels 3 to 4 (-5). Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
